question: What set of attributes must belong to that which is identified as the supreme reality in this description?
premises: That reality is designated as supreme.
It is described as partless and eternal.
It is further described as free from disease and stainless.
inference: The reality in question is the supreme, partless, eternal, disease-free and stainless one.
uncertainties: The ontological status of this reality beyond these attributes is not developed here.
plain_english: He is the supreme, partless, eternal one, free from disease and stainless.
